name: Native open and save dialogs, recent files and an unsaved-changes prompt
body:
# Open and save dialogs

Open..., Save As... and New/Open/Quit with unsaved changes. The dialogs come from penumbra-ui-backend's
`Application.ShowOpenFileDialog`/`ShowSaveFileDialog` (polled with `TakeFileDialogResult` in `OnUpdate`) once
`GAME-F02-T09` lands; until then the path field stays. Recent files (up to 10) and the last open world are kept in
the editor settings file. A modal dialog component (`Dialog.chaos`) asks Save / Don't save / Cancel.

comments.text: Done 2026-10-27. ShowOpenFileDialog/ShowSaveFileDialog through the Nyx Application bridge, polled each frame; recent files in preferences (File > Open Recent); ConfirmDialog.chaos asks before new, open, recent and quit when the document is dirty.
